description: On the table there’s a red plastic cup being handled, with a yellow bottle-like toy and a couple of small yellow and green cups sitting farther back. The left hand grips a blue textured scrubber while the right hand holds the red cup; the left hand pushes the scrubber into the cup’s opening, then both hands twist and slide in opposite directions to scrub the inside as the cup rotates and tilts, briefly pulling the scrubber partly out before pushing it back in to continue cleaning.
